create_regexpool_with_strategy: create a RegexPool with word or punct strategy to compile regex patterns for text tokenization
compute_str_offset: compute character offsets in text using compiled regex patterns from a RegexPool instance
get_levels_mask_prefill: get a levels mask for prefill byte sequences using a RegexPool with optional size limit
get_levels_mask_gen: get incremental levels mask for generated bytes after calling get_levels_mask_prefill on a RegexPool
shrink_to_valid_utf8_bytes: shrink a list of byte tokens to valid UTF-8 boundaries and return adjusted slice indices
